scope: Historical Markdown translations and Unicode test path fixture replacements in the GitHub export. Current quick-start translation is tracked separately.
raw_archive_policy: Original release ZIP bytes remain in the previous reviewed source package outside this English export. Historical checksum files remain original attestations; ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json records current export bytes.
semantic_policy: No production runtime, fixed S0, captured history, frozen labels, exact-triple scorer, or measured result was changed.
